title: Tim McGraw, Keith Urban, Blake Shelton & More to Play CMA Fest 2026
summary: The event will return to downtown Nashville in June, with the concerts held at Nissan Stadium.
contentText:
As summer inches closer, Nashville is preparing to yet again bring a cavalcade of some of country music’s most popular and entertaining artists to downtown Music City, with the return of the world’s longest running country music festival, CMA Fest, set for June 4-7.

As each day of the fest winds down, attendees know the music is just getting started, as tens of thousands of fans head to Nissan Stadium to enjoy sets from some of country music’s biggest artists.

This year’s lineup for the nightly Nissan Stadium shows will feature Bailey Zimmerman, Blake Shelton, Carly Pearce, Cody Johnson, Deana Carter, Ella Langley, Gretchen Wilson, HARDY, Jason Aldean, Jordan Davis, Keith Urban, Luke Bryan, The Red Clay Strays, Riley Green, Russell Dickerson, Shaboozey, Tim McGraw, Tucker Wetmore and Zach Top.

SoFi will again serve as the festival and broadcast presenting sponsor of CMA Fest, while the festival will again be filmed for a national television special set to air on ABC and Hulu this summer. The special will be executive produced and written by Robert Deaton and Alan Carter. This year marks the 23rd consecutive year that CMA has produced a summer music program to air as a network television special on ABC.

Meanwhile, The Band Perry and Stephen Wilson Jr. will offer mid-field performances at Nissan Stadium that week, while additional Nissan Stadium performers and Platform Stage performers, openers and the national anthem performer will be revealed in coming weeks.

Over the course of four days, CMA Fest will highlight an array of country music performers, ranging from storied hitmakers to bright newcomers. CMA Fest began in 1972 as Fan Fair, and over five decades has grown to draw an estimated 95,000 daily attendees. A portion of the proceeds from the event support music education initiatives nationwide, through the CMA Foundation.

Additional CMA Fest performers are set to be announced in coming weeks.
